content.text: For the subjects detailed in Parts I and II as well as the Food Administration of Delhi, Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep
International Agencies connected with commercial policy (e.g. UNCTAD, ECAFE ECA, ECIA, EEC, EFTA, GATT)
State Trading Corporation and its subsidiaries excluding Handicrafts and Handlooms Export Corporation and Central Cottage Industries Corporation.
International Custom Tariff Bureau including residuary work relating to Tariff Commission
Trade Fair Authority of India

Production, distribution (for domestic consumption and exports) and development of jute, jute products, handicrafts and all textiles and woollens including handlooms, powerlooms ready made garments and industries relating to the production of silk and cellulosic fibres but exclud ing non-cellulosic synthetic fibres (nylon, polyster acrylic, etc).
Handicrafts and Handlooms Export Corporation and its subsidiary.
Textile Committee
Commissioner of Payments.
Organisation of the Controller General of Accounts dealing with
General principles of Government accounting relating to Union or State Governments and form of accounts, and to frame or revise rules and manuals relating thereto
Reconciliation of cash balance of Union Government with Reserve Bank in general and, in particular of Reserve Bank Deposits pertaining to civil Ministries or Departments
Overseeing the maintenance of adequate standards of accounting by Central Civil Accounts Offices

Consolidation of monthly accounts, preparation of review of trends of revenue realisation and significant features of expenditure etc. and preparation of annual accounts (including Summary, Civil Appropriation Accounts) showing under the respective heads the annual receipts and disbursements for the purpose of the Union Government
Administration of Central Treasury Rules
Co-ordination and assistance in the introduction of management accounting system in Civil Ministries or Departments

Cidre Management of Group 'A' (Indian Civil Accounts Service) and Group 'B' Officers of the Central Civil Accounts Offices; and (viii) Organising of training and examinations for the Central Civil Accounts staff belonging to Groups 'C' and 'D
Release of Grants and Loans for the State Plans including advance Plan assistance towarus expenditure on relief measures in the event of natural calamities.
Plan Budget.
Properties of the union, whether lands or buildings with the following exceptions :-
those belonging to the Ministries of Railways and Defence and the Department of Atomic Energy (Parmanu Oorja Vibhag)
Buildings of lands, the constructions or acquisition of which has been financed otherwise than from the Civil Works budget

Buildings or lands, the control of which has at the time of construction or acquisition or subsequently being permanently made over by the Ministry of Works and Housing to other Ministries and Departments.
Central Public Works Organisation
Administration of Government estates including Government Hotels under the control of the Ministry of Works and Housing. Location or dispersal of offices in or from the Metropolitan cities.
Acministration of four Rehabilitation Markets; viz. Sarojini Nagar Market, Shankar Market. Pleasure Garden Market and Kamla Market

Formulation of housing policy and programme (except nodal responsibility for housing for landless rural labour which is assigned to the Ministry of Rural Reconstruction). Review of the implementation of the Plan Schemes. Collection and disemination of data on housing building materials and building techniques. General Measures for reduction of building costs. International co-operation and technical assistance in housing
Urban Development including Slum Clearance Schemes and the Jhuggi and Jhonpri Removal Schemes. International co-operation and technical assistance in this field
Town and Country Planning; matters relating to the Planning and development of Metropolitian areas. International co-operation and technical assistance in this field
The Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958.
Development of Government colonies.
The Delhi Water Supply and Sewage Disposal Undertaking of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.

Water Supply, sewage and drainage (excluding nodal responsibility for rural water supply which is assigned to the Ministry of Rural Reconstruction) Drinking water supply and sanitation. International co-operation and technical assistance in this field.
The Urban Land (Ceiling and Regulation) Act, 1976
The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974.
Delhi Urban Art Commission, Delhi Urban Art Commission Act, 1973.
Administration of Gandhi Samriti Samiti and Rajghat Samadhi Committee.
